The '''Venir system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Venir]].

==Description==
The Venir system served as a staging area for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] heading out of the [[Kuat Freight Port]].<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>
